name: online_retail_ii
title: UCI Online Retail II: invoice lines of a UK online gift retailer, 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09
description: All 1,067,371 invoice lines (sales, cancellations and adjustments) of a UK-based, registered, non-store online retailer of all-occasion gift-ware, many of whose customers are wholesalers; two worksheets of one xlsx file, parsed with the standard library into a compact NumPy table with pseudonymised customer ids.

license.summary: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, as stated on the UCI dataset page. Attribution: Daqing Chen, 'Online Retail II', UCI Machine Learning Repository, 2012, doi:10.24432/C5CG6D. Fitted parameters derived from it may be shared with attribution.

size.kept_on_disk: the archive (46 MB) and the compact table (4.5 MB)

provenance.publisher: Daqing Chen (London South Bank University), UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 502
provenance.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository static archive (official distribution)
provenance.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
provenance.population: 5,942 customers (anonymous five-digit ids in the source; 243,007 lines have no customer id) of one UK online gift retailer, many of them wholesalers, in 43 countries (mostly the United Kingdom)
provenance.platform: the retailer's own non-store online shop (business-to-business and business-to-consumer orders)
provenance.collection: the retailer's transaction records: invoice number, product code and description, quantity, invoice date and time, unit price, customer id, country
provenance.identification: observational (prices were set by the retailer, not randomised)
provenance.privacy: customer ids are replaced by keyed 63-bit pseudonyms (blake2b under a 32-byte secret salt kept outside the repository, mode 0600); product codes and descriptions (the retailer's catalogue) are kept; the extracted table is never committed
